name: Kobayashi Ryuugo
source:
A second-year student who is the ace of the football team. He used to be in the same middle school as [url=/c10479]Rikuto[/url], which is why he sometimes tries to make him join the football team. He is popular with the ladies and has a friendly personality, but has a tendency to lie sometimes. He has a motorcycle license as well and his favorite is [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Honda_CB600F]Honda Hornet[/url].
